scn_flow_traffic: Alerts when the connections that match the rule's condition grow by at least the set number within the set minutes.
scn_flow_bandwidth: Alerts when any one connection that matches the rule's condition reaches the set Mbps (its bytes divided by the time they span). Connections without byte data are not counted.
scn_flow_volume: Alerts when the connections that match the rule's condition carry at least the set MB in total within the set minutes. Connections without byte data are not counted.
scn_det_fanout: One host starts connections that were not blocked, on remote-execution or database ports, to at least the set number of hosts within the set minutes.
scn_det_new_admin_connection: A source, destination and port combination on a remote-execution or database port is seen for the first time. Judged only once the baseline period is full.
scn_det_pivot_chain: Host A connects to host B and B connects on to a third host, both on remote-execution ports and not blocked, and the two connect in time: the second is still seen after the first began, and starts no later than the set minutes after the first was last seen.
scn_det_blocked_surge: One source is blocked from at least the set number of hosts within the set minutes, on any port, and that is at least the set multiple of its highest count in the 7 days before. With no blocked attempt in those 7 days the number of hosts alone decides.
scn_det_non_admin_group: A source that is in none of the configured admin groups starts a connection on a remote-execution port, not blocked. Not judged until admin groups are configured.
scn_det_cross_env: A connection on a remote-execution or database port, not blocked, whose source and destination both carry the environment Label with different values.
scn_det_account_fanout: One user account starts connections that were not blocked, on remote-execution ports, to at least the set number of hosts within the set minutes. Only connections that carry a user name are counted. System accounts are left out when that setting is on.
scn_det_unexpected_initiator: On a remote-execution port that has a list of expected processes, a connection is started by a process that is not on the list. Connections without a process name are not judged.
scn_det_peer_deviation: A managed host makes a connection, not blocked, to a destination and port that no host of its group had used before; a group is the managed hosts with the same group Labels, at least the set number of them. Management ports, ports 49152 and above and public destinations are not compared; not raised when half the group or more starts the same connection in one run. Judged only once the baseline period is full.
scn_det_volume_surge: A source's connections or bytes over the last hour reach the set minimum and the set multiple of its own highest hour in the 7 days before. Judged only once 7 days of hourly activity have accumulated.
scn_det_account_new_source: A user account first seen at least the set number of days ago starts connections, not blocked, from a host it had not been seen on before. System accounts are left out when that setting is on. Judged only once the baseline period is full.
scn_det_suspicious_tool: A process on the suspicious-tool list starts a connection, not blocked, to a managed host or a non-public address. A remote-execution port that has a list of expected processes is not judged here.
scn_det_new_process: A process starts connections, not blocked, from a host for the first time, on a host whose process history reaches back the set number of days. Processes on the suspicious-tool list are not counted here. Judged only once the baseline period is full.
scn_det_auth_to_non_dc: A connection on a directory or authentication port, not blocked, goes to a host that is not a directory server (inferred from traffic, or declared in the settings).
scn_det_new_dc_client: A source that had never connected to any directory server makes its first connection to one on a directory or authentication port, not blocked. Judged only once the baseline period is full.
scn_det_directory_surge: A source's connections on directory or authentication ports over the last hour reach the set minimum and the set multiple of its own highest hour in the 7 days before. Judged only once 7 days of hourly activity have accumulated.
scn_det_direction_reversal: Host B starts a connection, not blocked, to host A when until then only A had started connections to B. Compared between internal hosts, on ports that are not management ports and are below 49152. Judged only once the baseline period is full.
scn_det_new_pair_port: Two internal hosts that had already connected start a connection, not blocked, on a port they had not used between them before. Not raised for a pair that had already used 5 or more ports, nor when hosts of the source's group already use that port toward the same destination or destination group. Judged only once the baseline period is full.
scn_det_quiet_host_wakes: A managed host that had started no connection for the set number of days, and was seen before that, starts at least the set number of connections in the last hour. Judged only once hourly activity has accumulated for that number of days.
scn_det_data_staging: Over the last hour at least the set number of internal hosts connect to one internal host, those connections carry at least the set MB, and that is the set multiple of that host's highest hour in the 7 days before. Judged only once 7 days of hourly activity have accumulated.
scn_det_off_hours: A managed host that was active on at least the set number of days starts at least the set number of connections in the last hour, at an hour of the day in which the kept history (up to 14 days) never shows it active. Judged only once 7 days of hourly activity have accumulated.
scn_sys_pce_health: The check of the PCE's connection and health fails 2 times in a row.
scn_sys_collection_failing: Collecting one kind of data from the PCE fails 3 times in a row.
scn_sys_data_loss: A span of time is newly recorded as not fully collected: collecting it failed, or the PCE returned as many rows as one query can return.
scn_sys_job_failing: One of this system's background jobs fails 3 times in a row.
scn_sys_disk_low: Free disk space on this system falls below the warning level set on the “Modes and data sources” page.
scn_sys_siem_backlog: For an enabled SIEM destination, the records waiting to be sent exceed the set warning number, or its DLQ is full.
